title: Declarative route contracts and staged schema migration for policy orchestrator
creator: Aisha Mahoney
description: Introduce a declarative contract layer for routing rules and a staged migration path for our existing DSL. The goal is to make region selection, tier routing, and fallback-model-variant semantics explicit as typed contracts that can be validated at config-compile time and softly enforced at runtime during rollouts. This ticket outlines the implementation of a contract compiler, compatibility checker, and a migration harness that can run feature-flagged validations against live traffic. We will prefer small, mechanical transformations for backwards compatibility and provide a safe rollback/fallback path for any incompatible rules. The work touches the policy interpreter, the validator library, and the operator tooling used by Console for rollout observability.
acceptance_criteria: Contract schema defined for region selection, tier routing, and variant fallback with examples
Static compiler that flags incompatible rule constructs with actionable error messages
Migration harness that can transform 90% of existing configs to the new contract form automatically
Runtime shim that enforces missing contract fields with warnings when feature-flag disabled and hard errors when enabled
Integration tests covering cross-region affinity, multi-tier prioritization, and chained fallback variants
Observability hooks that surface contract validation failures in Console with links to migration suggestions
comments: 2025-02-13 - Triage: scoped to contract compiler + migration harness. Decided to defer kernel-level routing optimizations to a follow-up.
2025-02-18 - Design review with PM (Lina Park) and Design (Jonah Raines): agreed on explicit variant fallback precedence and regional affinity weights. Jonah requested example map UI for Console.

2025-02-24 - Engineering sync: chose a staged migration strategy: (1) compile-time linter + warnings, (2) feature-flagged strict mode for canaries, (3) forced migration for release. Trade-off: slower rollouts vs safer migrations.
2025-02-28 - Prototype PR created for contract compiler. Initial tests show 87% of existing customer configs auto-convert. Filing follow-up to handle nested conditional routing cases.
2025-03-03 - QA found an edge-case where region aliasing (eu vs europe-west) leads to duplicate match rules. Added normalization step to compiler.
2025-03-06 - Security review decision: not required for this ticket scope, but key KMS integrations for Private deployments tracked separately.
Next steps: polish error messages, expand integration test matrix, add Console migration assistant, schedule canary rollout for 2025-03-20.
